steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Project Gotham Racing 3 Xbox360 Japan/Asia release only (En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko), title4D5307D1, default.xex built2005-10-30T23:26:30Z, as XGD2 ISO or complete extracted game files. NorthAmerican/European releases are untested and expected incompatible; bundled GeometryWars gw.xex is unsupported.

steps.instruction: Use Windows source build then play.bat configuration/launch with own supported PGR3 XGD2 disc.
